import os, sys
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.'):
    # skip hidden dirs like .codex
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith('.')]
    for f in files:
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        print(p)

import os, re
for i in range(3, 10):
    p = f'unpacked/ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout{i}.xml'
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        print(p, 'MISSING')
        continue
    xml = open(p, encoding='ascii').read()
    m = re.search(r'<p:sldLayout[^>]*type="([^"]+)"', xml)
    m2 = re.search(r'<p:cSld name="([^"]+)"', xml)
    phs = re.findall(r'<p:ph type="([^"]+)"[^>]*/>|<p:ph type="([^"]+)"[^>]*>', xml)
    types = [a or b for a, b in phs]
    print(f'slideLayout{i}.xml type={m.group(1) if m else "?"} name={m2.group(1) if m2 else "?"} placeholders={types}')

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ascii"?>
<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main" xmlns:m="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/math" xmlns:a14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2010/main" showMasterSp="1" showMasterPhAnim="1">
  <p:cSld>
    <p:spTree>
      <p:nvGrpSpPr>
        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>
        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>
        <p:nvPr/>
      </p:nvGrpSpPr>
      <p:grpSpPr>
        <a:xfrm>
          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>
          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>
        </a:xfrm>
      </p:grpSpPr>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr>
          <p:cNvPr id="118" name="Title 1"/>
          <p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/>
          <p:nvPr>
            <p:ph type="title"/>
          </p:nvPr>
        </p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">
            <a:avLst/>
          </a:prstGeom>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr/>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p>
            <a:pPr/>
            <a:r>
              <a:t>Thank you for your attention</a:t>
            </a:r>
          </a:p>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr>
          <p:cNvPr id="119" name="Body 2"/>
          <p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/>
          <p:nvPr>
            <p:ph type="body" idx="1"/>
          </p:nvPr>
        </p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">
            <a:avLst/>
          </a:prstGeom>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr/>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p>
            <a:pPr/>
          </a:p>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
    </p:spTree>
  </p:cSld>
  <p:clrMapOvr>
    <a:masterClrMapping/>
  </p:clrMapOvr>
  <p:transition xmlns:p14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main" spd="med" advClick="1"/>
</p:sld>

import io

def edit(path, old, new, must=True):
    with io.open(path, encoding='ascii') as f:
        s = f.read()
    if old not in s:
        if must:
            raise SystemExit(f'PATTERN NOT FOUND in {path}: {old!r}')
        return False
    s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
    with io.open(path, 'w', encoding='ascii', newline='') as f:
        f.write(s)
    print(f'updated {path}')
    return True

# 1) [Content_Types].xml: declare the new slide part
edit('unpacked/[Content_Types].xml',
     '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>',
     '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>\n  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>')

# 2) presentation.xml.rels: add relationship for the new slide
edit('unpacked/ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels',
     '<Relationship Id="rId12" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide5.xml"/>',
     '<Relationship Id="rId12" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide5.xml"/>\n  <Relationship Id="rId13" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide6.xml"/>')

# 3) presentation.xml: append slide id to the slide list
edit('unpacked/ppt/presentation.xml',
     '<p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>',
     '<p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>\n    <p:sldId id="261" r:id="rId13"/>')

print('done')
